relationships.evidence_quote: we treated HFD mice with celecoxib, an FDA-approved selective COX-2 inhibitor, for 1 week after injury

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: Celecoxib reduced HO-site and serum PGE2 levels

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, celecoxib significantly reduced HO in HFD mice but had no effect in control mice

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: providing substrate for myeloid COX-2-dependent prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) production

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 enhanced the expression of key collagen and ECM-remodeling genes (Col3a1, Itga5, Plod2) and osteochondral genes (Sox9, Runx2)

relationships.subject: EP4
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that PGE2/EP4 signaling directly regulates MPC gene expression to promote HO.

relationships.subject: linoleic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: dietary LA is required to activate COX-2/PGE2 signaling and promote aberrant ectopic bone formation

key_findings: High-fat diet enriches injury-site linoleic and arachidonic acid, driving myeloid COX-2-dependent PGE2 production that promotes osteochondral differentiation of MPCs via EP4 and heterotopic ossification.
Celecoxib or dietary LA reduction lowered PGE2 and HO in obese mice; COX-2 inhibition reduced HO only in obese patients.
